title: package.envelope@1
description: The one envelope extensions, packs, blueprints and kits share: the package's id as owner/name, its version, the frozen digest of its contents and, when signed, the publisher's key. Nothing else: a manifest carries these same fields at its root.

id.description: owner/name: exactly one slash between two names.

version.description: The package's semantic version: major.minor.patch, then a pre-release and build metadata as semver 2.0.0 writes them.

digest.description: The frozen digest of the package's contents, naming its algorithm: d1:<64 lower-case hex>.

publisher_key.description: The key the publisher signed the package with, when it is signed.
